title: Pointer to the properties of [def-pc-euler-characteristic]
text:
In the notation of [def-pc-euler-characteristic], the following holds. the well-definedness (finite support,
finite dimensions) is [lem-pc-euler-characteristic-well-defined],
the definition of Varieties, Definition 33.33.1 (Tag
[0BEJ](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BEJ)).
